items.briefing:
A new report highlights growing cyber risks from AI systems, cloud platforms, and web application vulnerabilities — all common in Australian training organisations. Separately, attacks on a US water utility serve as a reminder that critical services remain attractive targets, and the same risks apply locally. System administrators are also under increasing pressure managing security across complex environments, which can lead to gaps if staff are stretched thin.

If you're using a cheap TV streaming stick at home or work, be cautious — some devices come pre-loaded with malicious software. Stick to reputable brands purchased from trusted retailers.

featured.title: BreachLock report flags AI, cloud & web logic risks
featured.quote: Every AI system tested showed critical vulnerabilities, revealing widespread security gaps in Australian deployments.
